label: Stop infra
description: Scale a copy of an infra node down, keeping its disk: the program's own copy, or with `instance` that instance's copy of a `@per_instance` node. The triggers reading the copy go down per `triggers`; the runs using it follow `running`.

inputs.name: node
inputs.description: The infra node, named as the program writes it (`bridge`, `work.bridge` inside a group, or `one.bridge` inside an included file): a shared one when `instance` is unwired, one marked `@per_instance` when it is set.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: Whose copy: an instance id your program gives it (`user-42`), for that instance's copy of a `@per_instance` node. Unwired: the program's own copy. Wired, and no id arrives (the step feeding it did not run): this node skips.

inputs.name: triggers
inputs.label: Triggers
inputs.description: The triggers reading the copy: park keeps everything that arrives (answers, events, the trigger's own fires) and runs it once the trigger is back, while a caller on a route is told to try again in a moment; hibernate does the same for `graceMinutes` with its questions hidden, then takes nothing more; wipe drops it all. Starting the copy again brings back the ones it took down.

inputs.name: running
inputs.label: Running work
inputs.description: The runs still going that use the copy: wait lets them finish, cancel stops them. `wipe` needs cancel.

inputs.name: graceMinutes
inputs.label: Grace minutes
inputs.description: Hibernate only: how long it keeps accepting.

inputs.name: includeSelf
inputs.label: Stop this run too
inputs.description: On: this run is cancelled too when it is one of the runs reached.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the triggers reading the copy are down and the stop is handed off (or the copy was already down); the copy scales down afterwards.

outputs.name: noCopy
outputs.description: True instead of `done` when the copy does not exist: it was never started or was terminated before, or the instance id names no instance that has one. Wire it to tell whoever asked.

then.message: StopInfra '{id}' names {names} in `node`, which is no infra node of this program marked `@per_instance`. It is given an `instance`, so it acts on that instance's copy: name one the way the program writes it (`bridge`, `work.bridge` inside a group, or `one.bridge` inside an included file), or leave `instance` unwired to act on the program's own copy of a shared one.

StopInfra '{id}' names {names} in `node`, which is no shared infra node of this program. It has no `instance`, so it acts on the program's own copy: name one the way the program writes it (`bridge`, `work.bridge` inside a group, or `one.bridge` inside an included file), or wire `instance` to act on an instance's copy of a `@per_instance` one.
StopInfra '{id}' wipes the triggers but lets running work finish. Wiping drops what the runs still need, so set `running` to cancel, or pick park or hibernate for `triggers`.
